I have implemented the `EventListener.BatchDurable` callback and DB durability tracking, wait, notification, and stats APIs on branch `feat/batch-durable`:

- **Callback & Options** ([event.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/event.go), [options.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/options.go)):

  - Added [`BatchDurableInfo`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/event.go#L921-L930) and [`EventListener.BatchDurable`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/event.go#L970), wired through [`EventListener.EnsureDefaults`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/event.go#L1069-L1071), [`MakeLoggingEventListener`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/event.go#L1168), and [`TeeEventListener`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/event.go#L1255-L1265).
- **Commit Pipeline & Batch Integration** ([commit.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/commit.go), [batch.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/batch.go), [db.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/db.go), [open.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/open.go)):
  - Separated publish completion from WAL fsync waiting in [`commitPipeline.Commit`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/commit.go#L298-L376) and [`commitPipeline.prepare`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/commit.go#L448-L487) to accurately measure `ApplyDuration` and `SyncDuration` on Sync commits (as well as [`Batch.SyncWait`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/batch.go#L1712-L1725) for `ApplyNoSyncWait`).
  - Propagated WAL sync errors in [`DB.applyInternal`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/db.go#L836-L851) and [`DB.commitWrite`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/db.go#L889-L971) so `BatchDurable` fires and waiters/stats observe failures.
- **Durability APIs & Metrics** ([durability.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/durability.go), [metrics.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/metrics.go)):
  - Added [`DurabilityStats`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/durability.go#L32-L40), [`DB.WaitForDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/durability.go#L494-L496), [`DB.WaitForDurabilityContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/durability.go#L501-L512), [`DB.WaitForDurabilityBatch`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/durability.go#L516-L518), [`DB.WaitForDurabilityBatchContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/durability.go#L523-L534), [`DB.WaitForJobDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/durability.go#L539-L541), [`DB.WaitForJobDurabilityContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/durability.go#L546-L557), [`DB.DurableState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/durability.go#L561-L563), [`DB.DurabilityNotify`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/durability.go#L568-L570), and [`DB.DurabilityStats`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/durability.go#L573-L575).
  - Exposed [`Metrics.DurableCommitCount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/metrics.go#L384) and [`Metrics.DurableCommitDuration`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/metrics.go#L388), accumulated in [`DB.Metrics`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/db.go#L2104-L2106) only when `BatchDurable` is configured.
  - Added tests in [durability_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-qg9szf02/durability_test.go).
